name: Pension Scheme Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies a type of pension scheme.

AAVC.name: Additional Voluntary Contribution
AAVC.definition: Pension plan is an additional voluntary contribution plan.

DBEN.name: Defined Benefit
DBEN.definition: Pension plan is a defined benefit plan.

EXPP.name: Executive Pension Plan
EXPP.definition: Pension plan is an executive pension plan.

FAVC.name: Free Standing Additional Voluntary Contribution
FAVC.definition: Pension plan is a free standing additional voluntary contribution plan.

GPPS.name: Group Personal Pension
GPPS.definition: Pension is a group personal pension.

SIPG.name: Group Self Invested Pension
SIPG.definition: Pension plan is a group self-invested pension plan.

STKG.name: Group Stakeholder
STKG.definition: Pension plan is a group stakeholder pension plan.

IPST.name: Individual Pension With Tax Benefit
IPST.definition: Pension is an individual pension savings plan with a tax benefit. This is known as an Individual Pension Schema (IPS) in some markets.

STKI.name: Individual Stakeholder
STKI.definition: Pension plan is an individual stakeholder pension.

OTPM.name: Mandatory Occupational Pension
OTPM.definition: Pension is a mandatory occupational pension. This is known as an Obligatory Occupation Pension (OTP) in some markets.

OCDC.name: Occupational Defined Contribution
OCDC.definition: Pension plan is an occupational defined contribution plan.

PPNS.name: Personal Pension
PPNS.definition: Pension is a personal pension plan.

EPKA.name: Personal Pension Account
EPKA.definition: Pension is a personal pension account. This is known as Employee Pension Kapital (EPK) in some markets.

ITPO.name: Private Occupational Pension
ITPO.definition: Pension is a private occupational pension. This is known as an industrial and trade supplementary pension (ITP) in some markets.

REAN.name: Retirement Annuity
REAN.definition: Pension plan is a retirement annuity.

SIPP.name: Self Invested Personal Pension
SIPP.definition: Pension is a self-invested personal pension plan.

SSAS.name: Small Self Administered Scheme
SSAS.definition: Pension is a small self-administered pension scheme.

NWRP.name: Non Wrapper Pension
NWRP.definition: Indicates that the party does not operate the pension wrapper.
